subject: Error occurring in setting the path for the TxtInOut folder

messages.author: 14acf3cf1ba1a268
messages.subject: Error occurring in setting the path for the TxtInOut folder
parts:
Hello, I have a problem where the browser crashes immediately when I try to set the TxtInOut folder while using RSWAT. I have attached a screenshot of the error message displayed in Rstudio. I would greatly appreciate it if users and developers could provide a solution to this problem.
From what I can see, the problem seems to occur during the process of reading the HRU file. Upon comparing the header of the HRU file included in the example provided and the header of the HRU file I generated, I have determined that there is no difference.  
Therefore, I am attaching one HRU file that I generated as a sample for reference.

messages.subject: Re: Error occurring in setting the path for the TxtInOut folder
parts:
"First of all, thank you, Tam Nguyen, for showing interest in my problem. As the Korean localization of ArcSWAT/ArcGIS was being carried out, the generated HRU header included Korean characters. So, after removing the Korean characters and running it again, the issue was resolved. If I encounter any further issues or need assistance in the future, I will reach out to you. Thank you."
